description: Zonas de aludes INSPIRE de Cataluña is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoserveis.ide.cat. Information about snow avalanches of Catalonia. This data set is conforming to the technical specifications of INSPIRE Natural risk zones. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "INSPIRE snow avalanche zones of Catalonia" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 3 download or service links in ATOM, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.es). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
